<style>

.echo-questionnaire .question {
  margin: 24px 0;
  padding: 0 0 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  break-inside: avoid;
}

.echo-questionnaire .question .responses {
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.echo-questionnaire .comments-box {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 120px;
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid #70859a;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

/* Match the class actually used by your logos */
.echo-questionnaire .study-logos img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
}


.echo-questionnaire { 
--ink:#172b41; 
--blue:#005eb8; 
--border:#cbd5df; 
width:100%;
max-width:1200px;
margin:0 auto;
padding:0 24px;
color:var(--ink); font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.65; }
.echo-questionnaire, .echo-questionnaire * { box-sizing:border-box; }
.echo-questionnaire .logos { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; margin-bottom:32px; }
.echo-questionnaire .logos img { height:auto; object-fit:contain; max-width:100%; }
.echo-questionnaire .nhs { width:290px; } .echo-questionnaire .university { width:200px; } .echo-questionnaire .study { width:76px; }
.echo-questionnaire h1 { color:var(--ink); font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.35rem); line-height:1.2; margin:0 0 24px; }
.echo-questionnaire h2 { font-size:1.35rem; color:var(--ink); margin:32px 0 16px; }
.echo-questionnaire p { margin:0 0 16px; }
.echo-questionnaire .study-details { margin-bottom:24px; }
.echo-questionnaire .study-details p { margin-bottom:6px; }
.echo-questionnaire .notice { padding:16px 20px; background:#edf5fc; border-left:4px solid var(--blue); margin:24px 0; }
.echo-questionnaire .notice p:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }
.echo-questionnaire label { font-weight:600; display:block; }
.echo-questionnaire input { display:block; width:100%; max-width:100%; min-width:0; font:inherit; line-height:1.4; color:var(--ink); background:#fff; border:1px solid #70859a; border-radius:4px; padding:10px 12px; min-height:46px; margin-top:7px; }
.echo-questionnaire input:disabled { opacity:1; color:var(--ink); -webkit-text-fill-color:var(--ink); cursor:default; }
.echo-questionnaire input:focus-visible, .echo-questionnaire button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffdd00; outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #172b41; }
.echo-questionnaire .study-id { max-width:720px; margin:24px 0; }
.echo-questionnaire .column-head { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 210px; gap:24px; padding:12px 20px; background:var(--ink); color:#fff; font-weight:bold; }
.echo-questionnaire fieldset { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 210px; gap:24px; min-width:0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); padding:24px 20px; margin:0; }
.echo-questionnaire fieldset:nth-of-type(even) { background:#f6f8fb; }
.echo-questionnaire legend { float:left; width:100%; padding:0; font-weight:bold; margin:0 0 8px; }
.echo-questionnaire .statement-copy { min-width:0; }
.echo-questionnaire .statement-copy p { margin:0 0 10px; }
.echo-questionnaire .statement-copy p:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }
.echo-questionnaire .responses { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px; align-content:start; }
.echo-questionnaire .responses label { font-size:.95rem; }
.echo-questionnaire .responses input { text-align:center; }
.echo-questionnaire .signature-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:24px; }
.echo-questionnaire .signature-grid label { margin:0; }
.echo-questionnaire .wide { grid-column:1 / -1; }
.echo-questionnaire .version { font-size:.85rem; color:#465b70; border-top:1px solid var(--border); margin-top:32px; padding-top:16px; }
.echo-questionnaire button { font:inherit; font-weight:600; color:white; background:var(--blue); border:0; border-radius:4px; padding:12px 20px; cursor:pointer; margin-top:20px; }
@media(max-width:1300px) {
 .echo-questionnaire .logos { gap:20px; } .echo-questionnaire .nhs { width:230px; } .echo-questionnaire .university { width:165px; }
 .echo-questionnaire .column-head { display:none; }
 .echo-questionnaire fieldset { display:block; padding:24px 12px; }
 .echo-questionnaire .responses { margin-top:18px; max-width:600px; }
 .echo-questionnaire .signature-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:20px; }
 .echo-questionnaire .notice { padding:14px; }
}

.echo-questionnaire .responses input {
  margin-top: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.echo-questionnaire .agreement-options {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}

/* Put the question above its answer boxes */
.echo-questionnaire fieldset {
  display: block;
}

/* Five agreement boxes side by side */
.echo-questionnaire .responses.agreement-options {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
  max-width: none;
  width: 100%;
  gap: 10px;
}

/* Align questions with the main text */
.echo-questionnaire fieldset {
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 0;
}

/* Allow enough room for the text */
.echo-questionnaire .agreement-options input {
  padding: 10px 4px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* Use two columns on phones to keep labels readable */
@media screen and (max-width: 650px) {
  .echo-questionnaire .responses.agreement-options {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media print {
 @page { size:A4; margin:15mm; }
 body { background:white!important; }
 .echo-questionnaire { max-width:none; font-size:10pt; line-height:1.4; }
 .echo-questionnaire .screen-only, #quarto-header, #quarto-sidebar, #quarto-margin-sidebar, .nav-footer, .quarto-navigation-tool { display:none!important; }
 .echo-questionnaire .logos { margin-bottom:16px; } .echo-questionnaire .nhs { width:230px; } .echo-questionnaire .university { width:170px; }
 .echo-questionnaire fieldset { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 150px; break-inside:avoid; padding:12px 8px; gap:16px; }
 .echo-questionnaire .responses { margin-top:0; gap:10px; }
 .echo-questionnaire input { min-height:32px; padding:5px; border:1px solid #555; }
 .echo-questionnaire .column-head { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 150px; }
 .echo-questionnaire .signature-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; break-inside:avoid; }
}

@media screen {
  #quarto-content > main#quarto-document-content {
    grid-column: 1 / -1 !important;
    display: block !important;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: none;
    padding: 0;
  }

  section.echo-questionnaire {
    display: block !important;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
  }
}
